data.body:
**[P2] Merge accepted response state before suspending**

A tokenless response can still contain terminal operations in `NewExecutionState`. This break skips their merge and plugin notifications, leaving the invocation-end snapshot stale and omitting operation-end events used by OTel. If the service also terminated the execution, no later invocation can recover that information. Merge the inline operations without pagination and notify plugins before suspending waiters. Add coverage with a completed operation in the tokenless response.
